name: Great Plains Renewables
old_description: Before starting repairs, we consult with the manufacturer of your equipment to ensure that every repair is properly executed.
about:
Great Plains Renewables operates from Yutan, Nebraska, providing solar energy solutions across an eight-state region that includes Nebraska, Iowa, Kansas, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana, North Dakota, and South Dakota. The company has been a member of the industry directory since 2022, though its founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm delivers end-to-end solar services encompassing development, engineering, installation, and ongoing management for residential, commercial, and agricultural clients. Its offerings include solar panel repair and maintenance, battery backup system installation, portable solar power equipment such as Jackery products, and cold storage system integration. The company also handles storm damage repairs and assists customers with financing options.

Great Plains Renewables serves three primary customer segments: farms seeking to reduce operating costs through solar, businesses aiming for energy independence, and homeowners looking to lower their carbon footprint. Concrete examples from its project portfolio include agricultural installations that boost yields, commercial rooftop arrays, and residential battery backup systems for grid resilience.

The company distinguishes itself by consulting directly with equipment manufacturers before performing any repair, ensuring that each fix aligns with original specifications. Its stated mission is to help clients power their properties with a renewable energy mix tailored to their specific needs, leveraging experience across development, engineering, installation, and management to deliver community-focused solutions.
